standard_prerequisites.name: A complex L over B lies in D_comp(B, IB) if and only if T(L, f) vanishes for every local section f of the ideal IB generated by I
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces membership to the vanishing of explicit functors.

core_obligations: By the ideal-of-elements-complete-wrt lemma, L in D(B) lies in D_comp(B, IB) exactly when T(L, f) is zero for every local section f in I (proof lines 26623-26626). The cohomology of T(L, f) is computed in the category of abelian groups, so it does not matter whether f is regarded as an element of A or replaced by its image in B (proof lines 26626-26630). Comparing with the definition of D_comp(A, I) as the vanishing of the same functors T(-, f) over A, the preimage under restriction is exactly D_comp(B, IB) (proof lines 26630-26631).
proof_roadmap: Characterize membership in D_comp(B, IB) via the vanishing of T(L, f) (proof lines 26623-26626).
Note the insensitivity of T(L, f) to the coefficient ring and compare definitions (proof lines 26626-26631).
